digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture lifecycle / snapshot test cleanup
propositions: macOS CI pytest basetemp cleanup fails with PermissionError when snapshot-producing tests leave non-writable .rebar/run_snapshots cache roots
snapshot production intentionally publishes files/directories as 0444/0555 permissions, making them non-removable by standard rm -rf or shutil.rmtree
module-local teardown fixture in test_snapshot.py does not catch snapshot producers from other test modules, leaving orphaned read-only cache roots in shared pytest tmp_path

shared conftest.py autouse fixture must search and recursively remove only exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots below each test-owned tmp_path using snapshot._rmtree_writable to restore permissions before removal
adjacent non-snapshot temp content under tmp_path must survive shared teardown and remain untouched during cleanup
